question: Of crashes in Catalonia with a death or a serious injury, the share that were fatal, given the recorded road, conditions and crash
source: Servei Català de Trànsit, crashes with a death or serious injury, 2010-2023
estimator: logistic regression, L2 penalty, effects common to all zones plus deviations for urban streets and interurban roads
interval: 95% interval: logit +- 1.96 * sqrt(x' V x), V the covariance of the coefficients over 200 bootstrap refits

levels.label: Hit an object on the road
No posted limit recorded (the road's generic limit)

rules.text: Tick at least one road user involved.
The number of vehicles and pedestrians must be at least the number of kinds of road user ticked.
A crash in which a pedestrian was struck must involve a pedestrian.
A collision between road users with only one vehicle or pedestrian is rare in the records (36 of 24,478 crashes).
A crash involving a pedestrian and no vehicle is rare in the records (46 of 24,478 crashes).
Fewer than {threshold} recorded crashes share this zone, crash type, road users and number involved: the estimate rests on the model's assumptions more than on similar crashes.
Fewer than {threshold} recorded crashes in this zone have this value of {input}: the estimate for it is extrapolated.
On roads through towns the model barely separates fatal from serious crashes (ROC-AUC about 0.6 on later years); treat its estimate as the average for such roads.

evaluation.design: each year 2016-2023 predicted by a model fitted on the years before it
